title: Table Four
hook: Four in a row from your seat: point at a column, click, and watch your friend's pointer hunt for theirs.
prompt: four in a row with a friend

controls.primary: drop your disc in the column you point at (on your turn)

round.winBy: first to line up four discs

world.notes: A seven by six board on the paving; the players sit round it.

mechanics.as: four in a row on the table

rules.summary: Players take turns. On your turn point at a column and click (or press E): your disc slides to the free cell nearest your end. Four discs of one colour in a row, column or diagonal win. A full board is a draw. Alone, bots take the other seats.

characters.describe: a round jelly-bean kid sitting at the board

accept: each friend has a seat card with their name, colour and an avatar that reacts
a friend's pointer moves on my screen as they point
a friend's disc lands on my screen as they drop it
